📚 Item Details:
Title: 功夫旋風兒 (Kung Fu Boy)
Volume: 10
Author: 蛭田達也 (Tatsuya Hiruta)
Publisher: 東立出版社 (Tong Li Comics)
Language: Traditional Chinese
ISBN: 957-34-0166-5
Format: Paperback
Price printed on back: NT$60 / HK$25 / US$3
Condition: Very Good — light shelf wear, no major tears or markings. Binding is tight, pages are clean.
Edition: Official licensed Chinese edition (正式授權中文版)
🖼️ Description:
This is Volume 10 of Kung Fu Boy (功夫旋風兒), the classic martial arts manga series written and illustrated by Tatsuya Hiruta. Published by Tong Li Comics (東立出版社) in Taiwan, this edition features traditional Chinese text and vivid artwork true to the original Japanese series.
Front cover and back cover both feature the main protagonist in his signature brown leather jacket.
